name: 28326 · Cameron, NC
findings: ZIP 28326 (Cameron) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28326 (Cameron) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28326 (Cameron) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
